systems.system: Plataforma Comum de Comunicação de Dados do Governo e de Interoperabilidade (Plataforma Tecnológica de Interoperabilidade)
systems.country_label: Plataforma de Interoperabilidade de Governo Electrónico
systems.owner: INAGE manages it; INTIC specifies it
systems.tiers: all public administration institutions (central and local State bodies, local authorities)

note: Decree 67/2017 defines the interoperability framework as principles, standards, guidelines and architectures and tasks INTIC with proposing standards and a reference architecture, but names no set of technical standards (formats, codes, interfaces) and states none exists or is published; a mandate to write standards gives no fact, and the platform's functional specifications are an exchange platform's, so nothing for standing or use.
